title: fix(auth): prevent session timeout race condition during token refresh
author: sarah-codes
description:
### Problem
When multiple concurrent HTTP requests trigger token refresh simultaneously, duplicate refresh tokens were being sent to the authorization server, causing premature session invalidation and logging users out.

### Solution
- Added an in-flight refresh promise mutex in `SessionManager` so all concurrent callers await the same refresh cycle.
- Cleared the pending promise in a `finally` block.
- Added comprehensive unit tests simulating 5 concurrent requests sharing one refresh call.

### Checklist
- [x] Closes #142
